reason: I'm a solo freelancer — one human — so I land in the free tier and wouldn't pay $30 anyway. Even setting that aside, context switching between my own agents isn't painful enough to justify $360 a year; I can paste context between them, and Cursor/Copilot already keep context inside my editor.
objection: It's one local daemon that every agent depends on — if it breaks or the project stalls (it's a pre-sale with three pilot teams), my whole agent workflow dies, and as a one-person shop I can't afford that dependency.
would_change_my_mind: If I were managing a team of six-plus humans where sharing skills, credentials, and sessions across agents actually saved billable time.
